sources.tag: read: silent on stress
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing synchronic. a full-text search for stress/accent all 251 scanned pages: 'presyllable'/'sesquisyllabic' only in the Proto-Kra reconstruction chapters (pp. 160-215, *k-l-, *m-r- etc.); sec. 2.10 (p. ~38) says Pufeng (Malipo) and Pho La (Dong Van; Hoang & Vu 1992) Pubiao are 'very much the same variety'. No stress/accent statement for modern Pubiao.
